name: Jiangsu Financial Leasing Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Financial Leasing Co., Ltd. is a prominent non-bank financial institution based in Nanjing, China, established in 1985. The company specializes in providing diverse financial leasing solutions across various sectors within China. Its extensive portfolio of services supports critical industries such as the energy sector, encompassing financing for photovoltaic, wind power, thermal power, and energy storage stations. Environmental protection also forms a significant focus, with leasing services directed towards air and sewage treatment, solid and hazardous waste management, industrial and building energy efficiency initiatives, as well as centralized cooling and heating systems, among other specialized environmental segments. Furthermore, Jiangsu Financial Leasing provides financial backing for high-end industrial machinery, information technology equipment, healthcare facilities, urban public services, and construction machinery. The company also offers dedicated automobile financing services. Known as Jiangsu Provincial Leasing Co., Ltd. until April 2003, it subsequently adopted its current name, Jiangsu Financial Leasing Co., Ltd.
